text: On May 26, 2022, the applicant filed an appeal to the Ontario Land Tribunal in respect of City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on applications for a Zoning By-law Amendment and Official Plan Amendment for the lands municipally known as 670, 680 and 690 Progress Avenue. The Zoning By-law Amendment application seeks to permit the development of the Site with seven residential buildings ranging in height from 14 to 28 storeys and twelve four-storey back-to-back townhouse blocks with a total of 2,245 residential units. Two public streets and one private street are proposed within the Site. On March 5, 2024, the applicant filed a resubmission of the applications under appeal.
